factor_definitions.V5L02: stack_width_abs / RTH-local completed 1m Wilder ATR14; ATR resets each RTH day; min 14 completed RTH bars.
factor_definitions.V5L11: Count of PM/AH/PD directional levels strictly pre-cleared by the 09:30 RTH opening price.
factor_definitions.V5L12: RTH open location: BEFORE_INNER, BETWEEN_INNER_MIDDLE, BETWEEN_MIDDLE_OUTER, BEYOND_OUTER, or ON_LEVEL_BOUNDARY.
factor_definitions.V5S01: Identity/identities touched on DP1 bar; simultaneous within-bar touches encoded MULTI_* rather than fake ordering.
factor_definitions.V5S02: Identity/identities traded beyond on DP2 bar; simultaneous clears encoded MULTI_*.
factor_definitions.V5S13: Cumulative close-vector bit flips beyond each identity's initial flip, measured only through the current decision timestamp.
factor_definitions.V5S14: Ordered close-vector transition signature from 000 through the current decision timestamp.
factor_definitions.V5R08: Elapsed minutes and transition count since most recent 111 -> non-111 deterioration, measured through the current decision; primarily adjudicated at DP10-DP12.

leakage_guards: No final maximum levels cleared as predictor at earlier DPs.
No intrabar ordering invented when multiple levels touch/clear in same 1m bar.
